title: sambucus plumosa laciniata
intro: Sambucus plumosa laciniata, commonly known as the Cutleaf Elder, is a plant species within the Adoxaceae family, characterized by its unique, deeply lobed leaves and fragrant flowers. This plant has been traditionally used to support immune function and provide relief from cold and flu symptoms, thanks to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus plumosa laciniata include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
